description: Create a public read-only tracking link for a shipment, or return the active one (safe to repeat). Anyone with the URL sees status, ETA, route and events, but no tags or company data. Disable or regenerate it in the web app. `shipment` (required) is the BerthTime id, the tracked reference, or a container number on the shipment. Returns: shipment_id, created (false = the existing link), share_link {url, active, expires_at, view_count, ...}. New links need a paid plan (the Free plan gets an error). Needs write access: a read + write API key, or read + write access granted at sign-in by an owner or admin of the company.

company.description: Which company to act for: its id, @handle or exact name (see list_companies). Omit for the connection's default company.

shipment.description: BerthTime shipment id, or the tracked reference (container, bill of lading or booking number), or a container number on the shipment.
